name: gloobloom
description: A surreal global internet plant organism

scripts.dev:app: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run db:prepare && npm run dev:app
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.db:prepare: npm run prisma:push --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:prepare
